$meta.title: The largest filers in each sector, by reported headcount

measures.definition: Of the largest companies in a sector that file iXBRL accounts with a registered office in Burnley, the number reporting average employees in the band

$meta.table: iXBRL accounts joined to the register of 1 July 2026 (workstream B largest_companies.csv)
$meta.citation: Companies House (2026) accounts data, via workstream B
$meta.vintage: latest accounts each company had filed by July 2026; some have filed newer accounts since
$meta.caveat: Companies reporting 50 or more employees are named, each headcount checked against the company's own filed accounts on 25 October 2026. One is not named because its filing is internally inconsistent. Headcount is each company's average wherever it works, not jobs in Burnley. Large employers registered outside the borough, the aerospace branch plants and the public bodies among them, are missing.
$meta.rules: No person is named. Companies are named only in the largest filers panel, from their own filed accounts. No estimate is shown as fact. Derived figures carry their arithmetic.
